title: Rural park and ride
text: Upkeep check (T-4342, C:\Users\anita\projects\maps\trainworld\notes\T-4342.md): only the waiting room was too high (lowering it to $5k/day now, as you said). Rural lines mostly lose money before any upgrade; the park and ride is the big upgrade cost there ($40k/day, priced for about 1,300 spaces). A smaller, cheaper park and ride (say $5M, $10k/day) would match a real rural lot, but it changes what players can build. Add it? Buildings and passages come out low against real costs; I'd leave them.
